page.overview:
Who is Jack?

Jack is an unusually fashionable man, especially liking caps. He played baseball when he was in school. He is a high spender, using all the money he earns on clothes and accessories, to the point that his room is overflowing with them and there is no place to set foot in. In the future, he plans to open his own fashion shop. Lately, he appeared to be concerned with hair loss.

Jack has an average amount of health and deals moderate damage.
